description.zh: 恢复或停用公网精品带宽。
description.en: Specifies whether to restore the premium bandwidth plan of the cloud computer.
The ID of the premium bandwidth plan.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [](t2167755.xdita#)operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 恢复或停用公网精品带宽

descriptions.zh: 在开通互联网访问的情况下，如果想要暂时关闭云电脑的上网能力，您可以停用公网精品带宽，然后在需要时重新恢复。
descriptions.en: If you want to temporarily disable the Internet access of your cloud computer after the Internet access is enabled for your cloud computer, you can disable the premium bandwidth plan and restore it as needed.
